$comment: Settings of the planning stages (packages/agents). Versioned config, no constants in code. Gem kinds are ids from the data release.

s5.$comment: Calc profiles and tree objective of the endgame build, same as the skeleton's until the product owner sets other ones. Level and passive points come from the data release. ascendancyUnsupportedMods: avoid = the ascendancy search skips nodes whose mods Path of Building does not calculate; accept = keep them (then s10.acceptedUnsupportedModPatterns must cover them). ascendancyMaxRounds = how often the search repeats after banning nodes.

s6.$comment: Calc profiles and tree objective of the progression, same as the skeleton's until the product owner sets other ones. The stage table (acts, level bands, passive points) is derived from the data release; a `stages` list here would override it.

s7.$comment: DEFAULT budget tiers (ascending) and calc profiles, editable by the product owner. Tier ids must match the intake form (apps/web/src/config/intake-defaults.json). The item slots come from the data release; requiredSlots leaves out Arm and Leg (PoB lists them without a build condition, but they hold league-mechanic limbs, PoB data file incursionlimb), so every tier fills the rest.

s10.$comment: Gate inputs of S10. Stat names are PoB output names (pob_bridge/lua/runner.lua; MissingXResist is PoB's resistance still missing to the cap; chaos is not listed because a build reaching its cap through gear alone is not a requirement the product owner has set). CombinedDPS is used because FullDPS is 0 for builds without full-DPS groups. The thresholds are UNCALIBRATED starting values: half of the TotalEHP and CombinedDPS that PoB measured (mapping profile) for the stages of one run (gem Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceNova, class Sorceress, data release poe2-0.5.5.10+r12, PoB 0.23.1; the level 100 entry is r12's maximum level) (the endgame EHP with the last gear tier). They keep G4 and G5 from passing without a check; the product owner replaces them per patch and then sets thresholdsCalibrated to true. With no thresholds, G4 and G5 report the missing check instead of passing.

s11.$comment: Completeness score of the published guide: weighted share of non-empty parts. Equal weights until the product owner sets other ones.
